objects.name: base
objects.prompt: Pixel art modern desk setup, front view, straight-on camera angle. A clean, normal-quality wooden computer desk with a beautiful modern MacBook open and centered on top. Minimal desk accessories, wireless mouse, small desk lamp and a few tasteful accessories. Clean cable management, organized workspace, modern and comfortable professional developer setup. Noticeably nicer and more refined than a cheap starter setup, but not luxurious.  Centered composition, full desk visible from the front, isolated object, detailed retro pixel art, consistent proportions, transparent background.  IMPORTANT: NO CHAIR, NO STOOL, NO SEATING, NO PERSON. Only the desk and computer equipment.
